beats.text: This camcorder was found on the side of Elm Road. The boy who filmed it was never seen again.
beats.card: TAPE FOUND: ELM ROAD, OCT 16. OWNER: MISSING.

beats.text: My dad put cameras all over the house after things started moving at night.
Mom thought it was raccoons. My sister thought it was me.
Every morning, the back door was open.
And every night, the cameras glitched at exactly three o'clock.
So I stayed up with my old camcorder.
At 2:59, I heard the attic hatch open.
I walked down the hallway, filming.
Something tall was standing at the end of it.
Its eyes caught the light like an animal's.
I blinked, and it was gone.
Then I heard it above me, in the attic.
I climbed up with a flashlight.
Behind the boxes, I found a stack of tapes, just like mine.
Every one was labeled with the name of a kid who used to live here.
The last one had my name on it.
Then it started coming toward me.
I screamed for my dad and fell through the hatch.
Dad saw it too. That's the only reason anyone believed us.
We left that same night and never went back.
A week later, a note came in the mail. No return address.
beats.card: IT ONLY FOLLOWS WHOEVER HOLDS THE CAMERA.

beats.text: I threw the camcorder into a ditch on Elm Road.
But this morning, I found it on my nightstand.
Still recording.
